answer.sql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT MAX(event_date) AS as_of_date
  FROM <your_catalog>.<your_schema>.silver_gameplay_activity
)
SELECT profile_label AS label, title_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS active_players_30d
FROM <your_catalog>.<your_schema>.silver_gameplay_activity
CROSS JOIN latest
WHERE brand_scope_status = 'IN_SCOPE'
  AND event_date >= DATE_SUB(latest.as_of_date, 29)
GROUP BY profile_label, title_name
ORDER BY active_players_30d DESC
